title: Savannah Guthrie signs a new deal to stay on NBC's Today
summary: The co-anchor has extended her contract as the morning show enjoys its best ratings in years.
body:
Savannah Guthrie has extended her contract with NBC News and will stay on as co-anchor of the Today show, according to reports on Thursday 12 November.

Her previous deal was understood to be ending in the coming months. The length and value of the new contract have not been made public, and NBC News has not commented in detail.

More than a decade on Today

Guthrie joined Today in 2011 and became a main co-anchor the following year. She now presents the show with Craig Melvin, who took over from Hoda Kotb in January 2025.

She is also due to host a new NBC game show based on the word game Wordle.

Sources: People, TheWrap, Parade.
